# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 2.1.x   | Yes |
| 2.0.x   | Yes |
| < 2.0   | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately, not through public GitHub
issues. Preferred: use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting -- go to the
[Security tab](https://github.com/arvidn/libtorrent/security) of this
repository and click "Report a vulnerability".

Alternatively, contact:

* arvid@libtorrent.org
* ``arvidn`` on keybase
